items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I knew -- you know how you know the names of the guys in the band

ctx.x: Right. PeeWee Byers I don't know.
The two of them. Alto and tenor. Then they had Henry Bussey and this was before Roy Maxey even, you know,

I knew -- you know how you know the names of the guys in the band, but they had -- Fende [Grofé] Freddie was the piano player and of course, Whiteman was still playing fiddle, standing up anyway, but let me see, whether they had McDonald or George Marshall I don't remember.
